fixture_provenance: Original deterministic synthesis and/or explicitly supplied licensed recordings; see source_metadata and recording provenance

provenance.notes: Generated from oscillators, analytic envelopes, and seeded bounded noise. No external recordings, samples, or music streams are used. Piano-like and percussion labels describe synthesis test roles.

source_metadata.normalization: fixed synthesis gains; no per-render normalization

solo_piano.description: Piano-like additive attacks/decays; mild fixed partial inharmonicity.

connected_melody.description: Original eight-note sequence; 110 ms overlap of shaped harmonic voices.

harmonic_sustain.description: 32 exact harmonics at 110 Hz, 1/k partial amplitudes, gentle amplitude modulation.

percussion.description: Original kick sweeps and seeded noise/tone snare/hat events; no sampled percussion.

dense_mix.description: Fixed-gain mixture of the four musical synthetic fixtures.

quiet_dynamic.description: Identically shaped piano-like events with fixed gains from 0.006 to 0.46.

impulse.description: Separated positive/negative unit samples, identical in both stereo channels.

sweep.description: Linear 20 Hz to 0.46*sample-rate sweep with 25 ms cosine ramps; no pitch stationarity expectation.

simple_tone.description: 440 Hz sinusoid, identical in both stereo channels, 25 ms cosine ramps.

stereo_probe.description: Shared 220 Hz, antiphase 659.2551 Hz, channel-specific upper tones; mono is exact stereo fold-down.
